faq.mobile.a: Yes. Slash commands work the same on mobile and desktop Discord.
faq.regions.a: All of them. There are no region restrictions.

faq.panel.a: Run /panel in your server (you need Manage Server). The bot DMs you a link that works once and expires in 10 minutes.
faq.bugs.q: Found a bug or have an idea?
faq.bugs.a: Open an issue on GitHub; that's the fastest way to reach me.
about.head: About the developer
about.title: One person, one bot, made for fun.
about.p1: Hey, I'm Yanoee, a hobby developer doing this in my spare time. No team, no company, no investors.
about.p2: Every server bill comes out of my own pocket. DJ DIKKAT stays free for as long as I can keep it running, and that's a promise.
about.p3: The source is open on GitHub. No ads, no data selling, no dark patterns.
support.title: Keep DJ DIKKAT free
support.text: Hosting and audio servers are paid by one person, every month. If the bot saves you a paid subscription, consider Patreon; every patron helps keep it online.
translate.head: Translate
translate.title: Bring DJ DIKKAT to your language.
translate.text: The bot and this website speak English and Turkish today. Speak another language? Translate it and your name goes up here, with a link to your GitHub.
translate.step1: Request the language with the button below, or give a 👍 to a request that already exists.
translate.step2: Translate two files on GitHub: the bot's messages and this website. The guide shows which ones and what to leave as it is.
translate.step3: Open a pull request. An automatic check tells you right away if a line is missing or a {placeholder} got lost.
translate.step4: It goes live. Once it's merged, the language shows up in the bot and on the site, and you show up below.
translate.none: No community translators yet. Yours could be the first name here.
legal.privacy.head: Privacy Policy
legal.privacy.p1: DJ DIKKAT and djdikkat.com are run by one private developer (Yanoee). Questions go through GitHub issues.
legal.privacy.p2: For each server: its ID, name and icon, the channel used for the player card, its language setting, the settings made in the web panel (permissions, welcome messages, features), the ID of the person who added the bot, and every track played (title, link, and the Discord user ID and username of whoever asked for it). This powers /history, /stats and the web panel. It is never sold or shared.
legal.privacy.p3: When you log in: your Discord user ID, username and avatar, the list of servers you manage, a session cookie, and a hashed copy of your IP address and your browser's user agent for the session list. Login with Discord only asks for the "identify" and "guilds" scopes. Playlists you create are stored per server.
legal.privacy.p4: Web server and application logs (including IP addresses) are kept for 14 days to keep the service secure and working, then deleted. The site is served through Cloudflare, which processes requests on our behalf.
legal.privacy.h5: How long and how to delete
legal.privacy.p5: Play history and stats stay until a server admin resets them (/health → Reset buttons) or asks for deletion. Panel sessions end 7 days after you log in, or when you log out. To have your data removed, open a GitHub issue or contact the developer.
legal.privacy.p6: Only what is needed: the session cookie for the web panel and a language cookie. No tracking, no ads, no analytics.
legal.terms.head: Terms of Service
legal.terms.p1: DJ DIKKAT is a free hobby project, provided as is, without any warranty or guaranteed uptime.
legal.terms.p2: Don't abuse the bot or the web panel: no spamming commands, no attempts to break, overload or get around its limits, and no use that breaks Discord's Terms of Service or anyone's rights.
legal.terms.p3: The bot plays what users ask for from third-party platforms. You are responsible for what you play; the developer does not host any music.
legal.terms.p4: Panel access follows your Discord permissions: you can manage a server in the panel only while you can manage it on Discord. Never share your login link.
legal.terms.p5: These terms or the service may change or stop at any time. Access can be removed for anyone who abuses it. Questions: GitHub issues.

feat.head: Features
feat.hint: Extra tools for your server. Each one is off until you switch it on.
feat.leave.hint: Say goodbye in a channel when someone leaves. Nobody gets pinged.
